narrow_reuse_contract.manifest_binding: narrow_reference.manifest_sha256 binds the actual sealed V5.3 root archive_manifest.json, with1799files/465241564bytes. Full archive publication and independent readback are required before scientific release; missing or invalid binding is not executable.
narrow_reuse_contract.contract: Read-only exact existing V5.3 FIT features, targets, block/view IDs and actual-input receipts. Verify bytes, array identities, source, encoder and complete 256-block inventory before reuse. Retain original receipt separately; never relabel it as a new V5.4 cache.

anchor.release: only after both new models and complete FIT basis are frozen, published and independently read back

data.seed_algorithm: first 8 bytes little-endian of SHA256(seed_source), NumPy default_rng; role-specific source strings above are authoritative
data.matching: Replay original V5.3 FIT seed and RNG draw order. Use the same pre-rounding center uniform quantiles with wide bounds; do not invert the quantized narrow center. Non-position draws and rounded displacement must match exactly.

geometry.coordinate_rounding: nearest multiple of 2^-20, unchanged from V5.3
geometry.scope: Nominal continuous outer envelope spans original legal lane bounds; quantization leaves sub-6e-7 boundary gaps. This is neither complete joint-support matching nor reflected-trajectory training.

data.view_order: target-major, nuisance-path-minor; flat index=4*target_view+path; image index=2*pose+nuisance
data.nuisance_distribution: a,b independently uniform [0.1,0.9); retain coincident pixel centers and report their count without rejection or reseeding
data.target_contract: All 16 views per world used in both arms. Position labels change with center; motion labels, color and nuisance draws are bitwise paired across N/W. Each of the eight outputs is a separate ridge response, so changing position-label scale does not couple into motion fitting.
data.negative_control_targets: wide center position and exactly zero target motion; moving yellow, evaluation only, no additional encoding

bridge.release: only after complete FIT freeze/publication and evidence of no previous access

reader.world_loss_weight: Each of 256 worlds has empirical loss weight 1/256 in either arm; all 16 views weight 1/16 within a world.
reader.reference_order: all 4096 N views in block/view order, then all 4096 W views in the same order
reader.normalization_reference: all 8192 N+W FIT views equally weighted; no evaluation inputs or labels
reader.kernel_definition: center/trace-normalize linear kernel on joint N+W reference, apply (1+k)^2, then center/trace-normalize quadratic RKHS kernel on that same reference
reader.query_normalization: Both centering passes use all 8192 joint reference columns before selecting arm columns.
reader.solve: FP64 [[K_arm+4096*alpha*I,1],[1^T,0]] [coefficients;intercept]=[targets_arm;0], or algebraically equivalent Schur solve; one unpenalized fitted intercept per output/arm
reader.shared_score_baseline: Mean of all 8192 N+W FIT target rows. Position target means may differ between arms; motion target rows are exactly paired. This shared mean is a scoring baseline, not a forced prediction intercept.
reader.negative_normalizer: RMS of nonzero FIT motion targets; N and W must be exactly equal
reader.single_frame_models: none; N/W input-label distributions differ so the V5.3 S/B single-frame equivalence assertion does not apply
reader.selection: none; no CV, kernel/alpha candidates, seed/model selection, score-driven restarts or output calibration
freeze: both newly fitted coefficients and unpenalized intercepts
joint reference feature basis and arm row maps
shared target mean and FIT motion RMS
original N cache receipt plus W cache receipt and matching audit

primary_endpoint.loss: For each pair, mean squared displacement error over both variants and A_dx/B_dx in normalized coordinate squared units.

bootstrap.unit: complete paired world preserving variants, arms and coordinates

primary_endpoint.interpretation: Lower 95% endpoint above zero supports relative horizontal-error improvement from this registered supervised coverage intervention conditional on the fixed fitted models, not universal repair or memory.

bridge: all eight coordinate MSE/skills against shared FIT target mean
four-motion mean skill/NMSE and position skill
motion sign errors with zero/tie counts

spatial_groups.reference: narrow V5.3 coordinatewise cue outer envelope
spatial_groups.positions: Convert cached FP32 target labels to FP64; t7=position labels, t6=t7-motion labels. This is a label-quantization approximation to original continuous positions.
spatial_groups.pair_rule: Bridge pair outside iff any coordinate at either cue in either variant is outside; otherwise inside
spatial_groups.coordinate_rule: For each target coordinate and whole bridge world, outside iff that coordinate at either cue in either variant is outside; keep both variants together and report world/example counts
spatial_groups.anchor_rule: Wide anchor block outside iff any coordinate at either cue in any of its16views is outside. Coordinate-level block outside iff that coordinate at either cue in any16views is outside. Complement is inside; keep whole blocks and equal world weight.
outputs: N/W group dx and motion MSE plus per-axis/mean motion skills
N/W per-coordinate group MSE and skill
spatial_groups.skill_baseline: Frozen common N+W FIT target mean; denominator is conditional-group mean squared target-minus-frozen-mean. Empty groups or zero denominators yield null, not selected replacement thresholds.
spatial_groups.uncertainty: descriptive point statistics only; no subgroup CI or causal conclusion
spatial_groups.limitation: Coordinatewise outer-envelope proxy, not full joint support or empirical FIT coverage; correlated observations and potentially very small inside group. Wide-anchor overall performance alone does not establish narrow-region preservation; inspect the predefined inside subset and state when its size is inadequate.

anchor: wide fresh-anchor all/per-path/static/moving absolute motion skills
for each path separately, end=(view0-view1)/2 and start=(view2-view3)/2 against nonzero d
all per-coordinate target contrast skills; square per path before averaging
negative_control: RMS normalized by fixed nonzero FIT displacement RMS
N-W differences; square each direction prediction before averaging, never cancel signed responses before squaring
supporting_metrics.uncertainty: Whole-block/pair bootstrap seed7811 with10000 replicates for registered primary, supporting aggregate motion effects, anchor contrasts and negative-control RMS comparisons; supporting intervals are descriptive/unadjusted. Direction/amplitude/bias/covariance and spatial subgroups remain point diagnostics.
supporting_metrics.conclusion_rule: Report relative improvement separately from absolute motion competence. Positive primary alone cannot rule out output shrinkage. Examine W bridge coordinate skills, wide-anchor nonzero contrasts, registered narrow-envelope subset, amplitude/direction and negative RMS jointly; mixed results remain mixed. Enlarging range at fixed256worlds reduces spatial density and changes target-to-nuisance geometry, so a negative result does not reject every possible coverage intervention. No omnibus repair/P0 pass flag.

execution.gpu_management_jobs: none; no extra GPU profile or query step
execution.budget_rule: Inherit exact reconciled ledger; reserve each1.2GPUh envelope only with no unclosed lease and enough cap. Include startup/shutdown, failed work and accounting reconciliation. CPU fit/eval/archive steps request zero GPUs. No cap extension or automatic retries.
execution.metric_stop: none; evaluate and report both released roles regardless of metric sign
execution.failed_scene_policy: retain all existing scenes and sealed archives; retain this scene on runtime/archive failure or unresolved scientific outcome; no automatic P0 or cleanup

freshness.fit_independence: N is intentionally reused known FIT, W deliberately matched to its old seeds; neither is claimed fresh-independent. New anchor and original bridge are the held-out populations.
freshness.scope_limit: Known local old outputs/source/tests plus executor-inspected remote access records; not proof about unknown external experiments.
freshness.executor_required: Archive reviewed path/hash evidence and attest no prior new W FIT rendering/encoding or V54 anchor/Dev640..895 access before their authorized release. Any contrary evidence stops this registration; do not silently substitute IDs or seeds.
